categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: modified plastics, petrochemical materials, and fine chemicals. The modified plastics segment includes plastic particles and products used in holiday lighting, automotive, new energy batteries, home appliances, optical displays, cables, and medical hygiene. The petrochemical materials segment focuses on liquefied petroleum gas products and polystyrene. The fine chemicals segment produces halogen-free flame retardants, phosphorus chemicals, and raw materials for daily chemicals, serving coatings, modified plastics, electrolytes, pigments, and cosmetics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core proprietary technologies including halogen-free flame retardant chemical synthesis and application, flame retardant modified plastics preparation, functional polymer materials, and liquefied petroleum gas processing. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as solid-phase reaction control, one-step synthesis methods, and automated PLC production systems. The company also develops high-performance materials like expanded halogen-free flame retardants, flame retardant polypropylene, and high-purity phosphorus chemicals, supported by a national postdoctoral research station and collaborations with top universities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span multiple industries including holiday lighting manufacturers (e.g., Lisheng Group, Zhongyu Electric), automotive OEMs (e.g., GAC Toyota, BYD, XPeng, Dongfeng Nissan), new energy battery producers (e.g., CATL), home appliance brands (e.g., Midea, Gree, Whirlpool), optical display companies (e.g., LG Electronics, Samsung, Hisense), cable manufacturers, and medical hygiene markets in Africa. The company also serves petrochemical clients like Sinopec for gasoline additives and global coating companies such as Akzo Nobel and PPG.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases and subsidiaries across Guangdong, Anhui, Hunan, Hubei, Jiangsu, and other provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Vietnam, Nigeria, Cambodia, and Angola, targeting both domestic and international markets. Export sales account for approximately 29% of main business revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical materials supply chain. It produces petrochemical raw materials (upstream inputs), manufactures modified plastics and fine chemical products (midstream), and supplies application-specific products to end customers in various industries (downstream). It also extends into application product development and sales, integrating vertically along the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include platform-based hierarchical management, disruptive product innovation, and integrated industrial chain development. The company emphasizes R&D investment (3.4% of revenue), focusing on high-performance, multifunctional, and green new materials. Key R&D areas include LCD photoresists, polyimide monomers, organic and perovskite photovoltaics, anion exchange membranes, graphene conductive applications, biodegradable materials, and pharmaceutical films. The company maintains strong academic collaborations and patent portfolios to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of modified plastics, petrochemical materials, and fine chemicals. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with domestic and export sales channels. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or customs clearance for exports. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic high-performance plastics and resin manufacturer with differentiated competitive advantages in technology, product quality, and customer relationships. It competes with international giants like BASF, Sabic, Bayer, DuPont, and Dow in high-end modified plastics markets. The company has established strategic partnerships with major customers and is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' and manufacturing champion in flame retardant polypropylene.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.08 billion, a 10.72% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined significantly to a loss of RMB 236 million due to goodwill impairment and increased expenses from new business development. Total assets reached RMB 5.11 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.3 billion. The company maintains a robust cash flow from operations and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core proprietary technologies, high-quality product standards, and customized solutions tailored to strategic customers' needs. It offers environmentally friendly, halogen-free flame retardants and advanced modified plastics with superior flame retardancy, mechanical properties, and compliance with international standards (RoHS, REACH). Its integrated industrial chain approach enhances supply stability and product innovation, supporting customers in automotive, electronics, and new energy sectors with differentiated, high-performance materials.
